Ctrip.Com International LTD (CTRP) Holder Nomura Holdings INC Decreased Holding by $6.38 Million Posted by Adrian Erickson 05 pm
Nomura Holdings Inc decreased its stake in Ctrip.Com International Ltd (CTRP) by 8.79% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Nomura Holdings Inc sold 172,550 shares as the company’s stock declined 22.50% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.79M shares of the miscellaneous company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $66.51 million, down from 1.96 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Nomura Holdings Inc who had been investing in Ctrip.Com International Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $14.33B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.85% or $0.77 $26.28. About 3.68 million shares traded. Ctrip.com International, Ltd. (NASDAQ:CTRP) has declined 34.73% downtrending. It has underperformed by 34.73% the S&P500.
Nomura Holdings Inc, which manages about $28.50B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Morgan Stanley (NYSE:MS) by 528,617 shares to 628,617 shares, valued at $29.50M in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Altaba Inc by 1.76M shares in the quarter, for a total of 2.20M shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (Put) (NASDAQ:AAPL).
Analysts await Ctrip.com International, Ltd. (NASDAQ:CTRP) to report earnings on March, 13. They expect $-0.18 EPS, down 228.57 % or $0.32 from last year’s $0.14 per share. After $0.31 actual EPS reported by Ctrip.com International, Ltd. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -158.06 % negative EPS growth.
